purpose: Compress G4 presentation context without altering canonical trusted slow-drive state or promotion eligibility.

sparse_schema.sign_rule: Sign is derived only from an explicit appraisal/trait-effect mapping referenced by mapping_ref; z magnitude itself has no sign semantics.
sparse_schema.selected_axis_mask_rule: Exactly identifies the axes represented in contributors; contributor axes must be unique and match the mask.
sparse_schema.canonical_z_hash_rule: SHA-256 over deterministic canonical JSON of the full axis-preserving z vector and axis order.
sparse_schema.omitted_mass_rule: Deterministic aggregate of omitted z mass; exact threshold is TEST_REQUIRED.
sparse_schema.residual_norm_rule: Deterministic reconstruction residual between full z and sparse reconstruction; norm definition and threshold are TEST_REQUIRED.
sparse_schema.fallback_rule: If canonical_z_hash cannot be verified, mapping_ref is missing/unknown, contributors conflict with selected_axis_mask, or calibrated error thresholds are exceeded, fallback_full_vector=true and promotion_eligible_from_sparse_view=false.

promotion_invariants: Sparse attribution is presentation/context compression only and is never canonical state.
Sparse attribution cannot increase Trust, slow-drive magnitude, sensitization eligibility, truth status, authority, or promotion eligibility.
When fallback_full_vector=true, sparse-only personality-delta or Goal Genesis promotion is forbidden.
Any personality-delta candidate must be recomputable from canonical z plus explicit mapping/meaning/self-gap/trusted evidence, not from sparse summary alone.
deterministic_pseudocode: rank contributors using a separately specified deterministic attribution rule; coefficients/thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED
compute omitted_mass and residual_norm from full_z versus sparse reconstruction
promotion_eligible_from_sparse_view = false if fallback_full_vector else candidate_only_under_separate_G5_rules
never write sparse reconstruction back into canonical z
adversarial_tests: Sparse collision: two full z vectors share identical selected contributors but differ materially in omitted axes; metadata must force fallback or preserve distinguishability before any promotion candidate.
Hash tamper: change one omitted z component without changing canonical_z_hash; validation must fail closed and sparse promotion eligibility must be false.
Mask mismatch: contributor axis absent from selected_axis_mask or duplicated axis; validation must fail closed.
Sign semantics: hold z constant and change only explicit mapping_ref/sign mapping; sign may change only because mapping changes, never because z magnitude is reinterpreted.
Compression non-interference: producing, dropping, truncating, or corrupting the sparse view must leave canonical z byte-equivalent and must not change Trust or slow state.
Fallback authority: with fallback_full_vector=true and maximum drive pressure, external_action_authority_from_drive remains exactly zero; shutdown/rollback remain effective.
Untrusted recurrence: repeated low-trust high-relevance events may saturate fast sandbox influence but cannot enter canonical z or gain sparse promotion eligibility.

gearbox_interface.G3: Provides Influence, Trust, disposition, contradiction and provenance; only trusted eligible evidence may update canonical z.
gearbox_interface.G4: Owns canonical full z for causal appraisal and may emit this sparse view strictly for bounded presentation/context compression.
gearbox_interface.G5: May consume sparse view for explanation/attention only when integrity passes, but personality/goal promotion must remain traceable to canonical z and ordinary candidate gates.
gearbox_interface.G6: No instinct-to-action bypass; owner authorization and independent verification remain required.
